title: Availability updates immediately upon rent creation
gherkin:
Feature: Immediate Availability Synchronization
  Scenario: Availability reflects rent creation immediately
    Given an item is available for rental
    When a rent is created for that item
    Then the availability query must return the item as unavailable
    And the status change must be reflected within the same transaction
rationale: Validates that availability changes are applied immediately when rent lifecycle events occur (creation). This is a core requirement that availability queries must return the latest rent and item status information at query time.
usedContextItems: Availability changes must be applied immediately when rent lifecycle events occur (creation, modification, cancellation, completion)|Availability queries must return the latest rent and item status information at query time

Regardless of what the current SRS (v1.2) says about the dynamic Maintenance Matrix, we have an emergency with Concrete Mixers. 120 minutes is absolutely not enough for proper cleaning/maintenance.

Effective immediately:
- Concrete Mixers MUST have a 12-hour (720 min) maintenance window.

Please hardcode this for the Mixer category until the official Matrix is published in the next SRS version.

Best regards,
Tom (Operations Lead)
